build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places a jar and ball in a physics scene
add_dynamic_objects: create a dynamic jar and ball object in the PHYRE scene using C.add
add_static_bar: add a static bar to the scene floor split into target and non-target parts
update_task_goal: set the task goal so the ball must touch the bottom wall using C.update_task
skip_invalid_params: raise SkipTemplateParams when the ball hovers over the jar or jar is out of bounds
